decision_conditions: The proposal, the rear dormer extension in particular, by reason of its orientation, design, excessive size, height and width and the choice of flat roof form, would appear box-like and top-heavy in the context of the existing property and would constitute an overbearing and incongruous addition to the dwelling that would be highly visible from the road east of the site, adversely impacting on the character and appearance of the host building, the Rotherfield Road street scene and the surrounding area. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018 and the guidance within Supplementary Planning Document 'Design of Residential Extensions' (SPD4) and Sutton's Urban Design Guide 'Creating Locally Distinctive Places' SPD (SPD14).

The proposed front dormer extension, due to its orientation, unsympathetic design, excessive size, height and width, would lack subordination to the main dwelling, resulting in a bulky and overly dominated appearance to the principle elevation and would cause significant harm to the character and appearance of the dwelling and the streetscene characterised with modest front dormer windows. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018 and the guidance within Supplementary Planning Document 'Design of Residential Extensions' (SPD4) and Sutton's Urban Design Guide 'Creating Locally Distinctive Places' SPD (SPD14).

The proposal, by reason of its excessive height, width and bulky appearance in close proximity to the boundaries shared with Nos. 2 and 4 Lakin Close and the rear garden areas of 5 and 6 Lakin Close, would result in significant harm to the outlook of these properties, creating an undue sense of enclosure. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018 and the guidance contained within SPD 4 'Design of Residential Extensions'.
description: Conversion of loft space involving dormer extensions at the front and rear.
